record.original_question: For the binary narrow-sense BCH codes of length 511, determine the true minimum distances of the six unresolved codes with designed distances 59, 61, 75, 77, 85, and 107.

evidence.quote: The value of d is not known for six codes. These are the BCH codes with designed distance 59 , 61 , 75 , 77 , 85 and 107.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n=511=2^9-1$ and work over $\mathbb{F}_2$. Let $\alpha$ be a primitive element of $\mathbb{F}_{2^9}$. For an integer $\delta$ with $2\le\delta\le n$, the binary narrow-sense BCH code $\mathrm{BCH}(n,\delta)$ of length $n$ and designed distance $\delta$ is the cyclic code of length $n$ over $\mathbb{F}_2$ whose generator polynomial is the least common multiple of the minimal polynomials over $\mathbb{F}_2$ of $\alpha,\alpha^2,\dots,\alpha^{\delta-1}$. Its true minimum distance $d$ is the minimum Hamming weight of a nonzero codeword, and by the BCH bound $d\ge\delta$.

Determine the exact value of the true minimum distance $d$ of the binary narrow-sense BCH code of length $511$ for each of the six designed distances
$$\delta\in\{59,\;61,\;75,\;77,\;85,\;107\}.$$
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not turn up a paper resolving the true minimum distances of the binary narrow-sense BCH codes of length 511 for designed distances 59, 61, 75, 77, 85, 107. Recent work on minimum distances of BCH codes addresses other parameter families (e.g., designed distance $2^{m-2}+1$ for odd $m$), and general statements in the literature emphasize that determining true minimum distances of BCH codes is hard. No definitive resolution of these six length-511 cases was found.

status_evidence.title: On the minimum distance of a class of binary BCH codes
status_evidence.snippet: Determines minimum distance of BCH codes with designed distance 2^{m-2}+1 for odd m, 5<=m<=15; does not cover designed distances 59,61,75,77,85,107 at length 511.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work resolves other BCH minimum-distance cases but not the six length-511 designed distances in question.

status_evidence.title: BCH Codes with Minimum Distance Proportional to Code Length
status_evidence.snippet: Studies BCH codes with minimum distance proportional to length; general results, no specific resolution of the six length-511 cases.
status_evidence.claim: General progress on BCH minimum distances does not settle these specific six codes.
